title.en: Kofta on the oven, salad on the arm, koshari on the fryer robot

goal.en: Three recipes, each on the preset built for it: the smart oven bakes the kofta while a person prepares it, the counter arm washes and cuts the salad, and the fryer robot does all of koshari including the deep-fried onions.

note.en: Kofta in the oven: the oven bakes (verified by its oven thermometer); grating, cutting, mixing and forming are the person's.
Salad on the counter arm: it washes, cuts under its camera, whisks and mixes; chilling and serving are the person's.
Koshari on the robot with an oil thermometer: twenty steps by the device, the deep fry verified by the oil thermometer.
The oven alone cannot grate an onion and nobody is there to do it: refused before heat.

outcome.en: Every example recipe now has a device that plans it. An appliance that covers only part of a recipe is still useful when a person is present; alone it is refused with the first missing operation named. Next: scenario 032 looks closer at the oven and its core probe.
